payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used for document classification tasks, detailing their sources and characteristics.

claims.text: The datasets used include Reuters, BBCSport, Polarity, Subjectivity, and MPQA.
Reuters dataset contains stories from the Reuters news agency collected in 1987.
BBCSport dataset includes sports news articles from the BBC Sport website from 2004-2005.
Polarity dataset features positive and negative labeled snippets from Rotten Tomatoes.
Subjectivity dataset contains movie review snippets and plot summaries from Rotten Tomatoes and IMDb.
MPQA dataset consists of positive and negative phrases annotated for multi-perspective question answering.
